meta.promptText: India mein 2000 rupees ke andar men ke liye konse brand ki jeans kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Haan, **₹2,000 ke andar** India mein kaafi achhi branded jeans mil jaati hain. Mere hisaab se quality + fit + value ke liye ye ranking best rahegi:

1. **Levi’s — Best overall** ⭐  
   Sale mein 511/513/505 jaise models ₹1,300–₹1,900 ke aas-paas mil sakte hain. [Levi's 513 Slim Men Blue Jeans]() [Levi's 505 Straight Fit Men Mid Rise Jeans]()  
   **Agar ek hi jeans leni hai, Levi’s meri first choice hai.** [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/fashion/top-levis-jeans-for-men-under-2000-9201855?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. **Pepe Jeans — Best stylish option**  
   Sale mein ₹1,350–₹1,900 tak achhe straight/slim fits mil rahe hain. [Pepe Jeans Men's Holborne Mid Rise Straight Jeans]() [Pepe Jeans Men's Straight Fit Jeans]() [www.pepejeans.in](https://www.pepejeans.in/men/jeans?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

3. **Lee — Best comfort + classic look**  
   Lee Travis Slim jaise options ₹1,650 ke aas-paas mil rahe hain. [Lee Men's Travis Slim Jeans]()

4. **H&M — Best modern/relaxed fit**  
   Regular aur relaxed jeans ₹1,400–₹2,000 range mein available hain. [Men H&M Regular Jeans At NykaaMan]() [H&M Men's Relaxed Jeans]()

5. **Flying Machine — Best budget branded**  
   ₹1,000–₹1,500 ke around mil jaati hai; daily/college wear ke liye achhi value. [Flying Machine Men's Jackson Skinny Fit Jeans]() [magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/top-jeans-brands-in-india-men?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

6. **Roadster — Cheapest decent option**  
   ₹700–₹1,000 ke range mein kaafi options milte hain. [The Roadster Life Co. Men's Slim Fit Stretchable Jeans]() [zoutons.com](https://zoutons.com/news/best-branded-jeans-ajio-under-1500?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Meri short recommendation:**  
- 👑 **Quality:** Levi’s  
- 😎 **Style:** Pepe Jeans  
- 👖 **Comfort:** Lee  
- 💰 **₹1,000 ke andar:** Flying Machine / Roadster  
- 🔥 **Trendy loose/relaxed look:** H&M

Agar tum **apni height, weight aur waist size** bata do (jaise **5'8", 70 kg, 32 waist**), main tumhare body type ke hisaab se **exact fit — slim, straight, relaxed ya tapered — aur 3–5 best jeans** choose kar dunga.
